items.titleZh: 祸不单行！安东内利练习赛退场后被消防员喷水
items.summaryZh: 安东内利的梅赛德斯因液压系统故障提前结束阿塞拜疆大奖赛第一节练习赛，之后还被消防员喷了水。

media.altZh: 祸不单行！安东内利练习赛退场后被消防员喷水

items.originalTitle: Bad to worse! Antonelli out of practice then sprayed by marshal
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli ended the first practice session early at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after a hydraulics failure, and was sprayed by a marshal after his car broke down.
detailZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛：基米·安东内利的赛车抛锚后被赛道工作人员喷水！
由于梅赛德斯赛车液压系统故障，基米·安东内利提前结束了第一节练习赛。
科拉平托为导致与队友相撞的"重大失误"道歉
巴库最终圈戏剧性一幕：拉塞尔以微弱优势击败维斯塔潘夺冠！
惨烈事故！诺里斯在多车相撞中退出了阿塞拜疆大奖赛！
阿尔本撞上护栏，安全车出动
红牛梦幻开局，维斯塔潘和哈贾尔展现出惊人速度！
拉塞尔完美起步，守住巴库领跑位置！
“眼睛与耳朵”——在比赛日实时观看迈凯伦任务控制中心（Mission Control）里发生了什么！
“这不是一个容易的地方”——法拉利会不会签下霍纳（Horner）？他曾发表过关于“梦想”职位的言论
拉塞尔对自己在阿塞拜疆排位赛中的统治级表现感到“非常惊讶”
“情况相当糟糕”——汉密尔顿在排位赛获得第六名后情绪低落
「对此非常懊恼」| 安东内利在一练第四节排位（Q1）中发生“不必要的”撞车后感到沮丧
detailEn: Azerbaijan GP: Kimi Antonelli gets sprayed by marshal after car breaks down!
Kimi Antonelli ends the first practice session early after a hydraulics failure on his Mercedes.
CARNAGE as Norris out of Azerbaijan GP in multi-car crash!
Albon slams into the wall and brings out safety car
DREAM start for Red Bull as Verstappen and Hadjar show stunning pace!
Super start for Russell as he holds onto Baku lead!
'Eyes and ears' - See what happens at McLaren Mission Control live on race day!
'It's not an easy place' - Could Ferrari sign Horner following 'dream' role comments?
Russell 'very surprised' by his dominance during Azerbaijan qualifying
'It was pretty bad' - Hamilton despondent after qualifying sixth
'Very mad about it' | Antonelli frustrated after 'unnecessary' Q1 crash
Azerbaijan Grand Prix | Qualifying Highlights
Qualifying drama! Antonelli OUT in Q1 after hitting wall!
Russell narrowly avoids crash into wall after lock-up during FP3!
keyPointsZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛上安东内利的赛车发生故障，消防员向他喷了水。
同队的拉塞尔在巴库最后一圈击败维斯塔潘夺冠。
科拉平托为导致与队友相撞的'重大失误'道歉。
keyPointsEn: The failure was caused by a hydraulics problem on his Mercedes car.
Lando Norris was also out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in a multi-car crash.
